title: Slack-to-Asana Marketing Campaign Setup Automation
summary: A request in Slack becomes a fully scheduled Asana campaign, with deadlines, email drafts and documents, built from the right template.
headline: From a Slack message to a full campaign plan
problem: Setting up a campaign for every event by hand was slow and inconsistent.
solution: n8n listens to a Slack channel, reads the event details from the message and the event website, duplicates the correct Asana template, generates a schedule, sets subtask deadlines, drafts the emails and attaches the right package documents.
highlights: Event data extracted from the message and website
role: Sole engineer. I built the whole workflow and the AI prompts.

results.label: Consistent campaign setup for every event
Manual project setup and human error reduced
